new_discovery_1511735208.vlm_3p_explanation: This spectrum represents a mixed chloride-bearing sodium orthophosphate ('3-P') grain. It exhibits a strong salt backbone at 23 u and 63 u (prom=0.418) and passes the orthophosphate triplet criteria: the 125 u Na+(NaPO3) peak (prom=0.118) is clearly aligned with the 125 u green band rather than the 129 u carbonate band (diff_125_minus_129=+0.0552), alongside positive features in the 165 u Na+(Na2HPO4) band (prom=0.047 >= 0.045) and the 187 u Na+(Na3PO4) band (prom=0.068 >= 0.065), while the 81 u chloride peak remains below the pure 3-Cl veto thresholds (p81=0.292 <= 0.30, 81u/63u ratio=0.90, p139=0.107 < 0.145).
